description: This file defines the NullIdMap class, a dummy implementation of the MigrateIdMapInterface in Drupal's migration system, serving as a placeholder that does not store or process any data.

classes.name: NullIdMap
classes.description: A dummy implementation of the MigrateIdMapInterface that performs no actual data storage or retrieval, used as a placeholder in Drupal migrations.

methods.name: setMessage
methods.description: Intended to set a message, but does nothing in this implementation.

methods.name: getRowBySource
methods.description: Returns an empty array, indicating no row found for given source ID values.

methods.name: getRowByDestination
methods.description: Returns an empty array, indicating no row found for given destination ID values.

methods.name: getRowsNeedingUpdate
methods.description: Returns 0, indicating no rows need update.

methods.name: lookupSourceId
methods.description: Returns an empty array, indicating no source ID found for given destination ID values.

methods.name: lookupDestinationIds
methods.description: Returns an empty array, indicating no destination IDs found for given source ID values.

methods.name: saveIdMapping
methods.description: Does nothing, as this is a dummy implementation.

methods.name: getMessages
methods.description: Returns an empty ArrayIterator, indicating no messages.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Returns FALSE, indicating the iterator is invalid.
